Then template 2895 applied to first precursor gave a nitro substitution? Actually gave product with nitro group. Then template 1914397 applied to that gave two precursors: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCNCC1 (tert-butyl carbamate piperazine?) and O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2 (a bromonitro aromatic fused ring). Next we need to apply template 1914398 to one of these precursors (likely the aromatic bromonitro). Then 1914399, then 74054. Need to ensure at least 6 reactions total. We have 3 so far, need 3 more.
